notConfirmed: The headset did not confirm the change. Refresh before retrying.
busyError: Another headset operation is running. Try again shortly.
unavailable: Headset controls are unreachable. Close Razer Audio on your phone and refresh.
switchRequested: Bluetooth source switch requested. Refresh to check the active source.
eqInternal: The headset’s built-in EQ. Settings stay on the headphones.
relativeLevels: Relative levels from −5 to +5; not a measured dB scale.
phrase4: Your next level has a soundtrack
quickGaming: Turn gaming mode off to use Quick Connect.
